label: WRONG
reason: The only outlier is routes/sliderule.ts, the HTTP surface of the SlideRule feature, which imports its adapter layer (python-delegation, execute-capability-log) by design; architecture.ts.json declares server-routes mayDependOn server-sliderule. reason: No lint exists and the arch gate (scripts/arch-graph-ts.mjs) would not catch a new core->routes import because 'server-core -> server-routes' is already in architecture.ts.json baseline.componentCyclicEdges, which the repo frames as cycle debt to repay; vision-output.ts pulls a plain getMimeType helper from routes/artifact-utils, and the two workflow-engine files import routes/node-adapters that themselves import core (chat-node-adapter.ts), closing the core<->routes cycle, so each is worth a second look.
